skateddu-claude-code-python-setup-django.description: Run the full Django verification loop — environment check, mypy and ruff checks, migration safety, pytest with coverage targets, pip-audit and bandit security scans, settings and logging review, and diff review — producing a phased pass/fail report before release or PR. Use when preparing a Django pull request, validating migrations or coverage, or running pre-deploy readiness checks.

skateddu-claude-code-python-setup-docker.description: Docker and Docker Compose patterns for local development, container security, networking, volumes, and multi-service orchestration. Use when creating or reviewing Dockerfiles and Compose services, or troubleshooting container networking or volumes.
